html:
The Slovak State was a client state of Nazi Germany that existed from March 1939 to April 1945, led by the Catholic priest Jozef Tiso. It was the first state ever called Slovak.

It was declared on the eve of Germany's occupation of the Czech lands, at Hitler's urging. Tiso's Slovak People's Party ruled as the only party. Slovakia joined the invasion of Poland and the war on the Soviet Union. In 1942 it deported about 58,000 Jews to the death camps in occupied Poland, and paid Germany for each one. Opposition grew into the Slovak National Uprising of 1944. Tiso was hanged in 1947. The state still divides opinion in Slovakia.
sum: The Slovak State was a client state of Nazi Germany that existed from March 1939 to April 1945, led by the Catholic priest Jozef Tiso. It was the first state ever called Slovak.
